Type: deco
Name: AmazonBasics Fabric Storage Basket Container with Rope Handles, Set of 2, Medium
Medium-size attractive storage basket (2-pack) for neatly storing everyday items Made of non-woven fabric and high-quality cardboard for reliable structure Ideal for a bedroom, playroom, or living room; simple, classic style for easy coordinating Side loop handles for easy carrying or pulling off a shelf; folds for compact storage Measures 15.7 by 11.8 by 8.3 inches each; backed by an AmazonBasics 1-year limited warranty
